On Monzo’s **free UK plan**, an **Instant Access Savings Pot pays 2.80% AER (variable)**, with no minimum deposit and unlimited withdrawals. That’s about **£28 on £1,000** left in the Pot for a year if the rate stays the same. A regular budgeting Pot doesn’t earn interest. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/savings-isas))

If you don’t need the money as often, the free plan also offers:

- **Select Access: 3.45% AER (variable)** with a £500 minimum deposit. You keep that rate if you make no more than two withdrawals per Pot year; a third withdrawal lowers it until the Pot’s next anniversary. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/savings-isas))
- **Three-year fixed: 5.25% AER**, with a £500 minimum deposit and interest paid at the end of the term. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/savings-isas))

If you already pay for a Monzo plan, the **Instant Access** rates are **3.15% on Extra, 3.55% on Perks and 3.80% on Max**, all variable. Monzo’s equivalent Cash ISAs offer the same rates, with tax-free interest. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/savings-isas))
